image_description: A medium shot of a person wearing a yellow academic gown with black velvet panels and a black mortarboard cap. The subject is holding a white diploma or certificate folder. The background shows other people in similar attire, suggesting a graduation ceremony outdoors.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/hip level; the lower half of the gown and ankles are not visible.
The front of the gown is visible, showing a clear center opening with black vertical panels symmetrically placed on either side.
The fabric hangs loosely around the arms and torso, successfully hiding the underlying body shape.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeve on the left arm is clearly visible, featuring the characteristic wide, bell-shaped drape that extends past the wrist/hand area.
Distinct black vertical panels (likely velvet) are present along the front opening, typical of doctoral or master's gowns.
A white collared shirt is visible underneath the gown at the neckline.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the black panels appear matte, the main body of the gown is bright yellow. The color deviates from the 'typically black' description, though the material texture appears consistent with heavy matte fabric.
The yellow fabric shows soft folds and diffuse lighting, indicating a non-reflective, matte finish consistent with gabardine or polyester blends.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Confirmed by the visible left sleeve which hangs heavily and extends beyond the wearer's hand.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The shading in the deep folds of the yellow gown appears slightly smudged or painterly, lacking the crisp micro-texture of real woven fabric, though this may be due to image compression.
The white object held by the subject has ambiguous geometry; the edges seem to merge slightly with the hands and the red interior lacks clear structural definition, appearing somewhat melted.
Standard depth-of-field blur, but some background faces show slight distortion typical of AI generation rather than optical bokeh.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the specific style (yellow with black panels) corresponds to a valid academic regalia class and to confirm the 'academic gown' label despite the color deviation.
To check for edge bleeding between the complex sleeve shapes and the background/body, and to ensure the gown is a single continuous mesh.
To analyze the 'smudged' appearance of the yellow fabric and determine if it is an artifact or just low resolution/compression.
To identify the object being held and provide bounding boxes for closer inspection of its structural integrity.

focus_areas: Sleeve geometry and connection to shoulder
Structural logic of the held object (diploma)
Boundary sharpness between gown and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the yellow fabric's texture. Real academic gowns have a distinct weave; AI often renders them as smooth plastic or overly blurred cloth. Also, inspect the hands holding the white folder—AI frequently struggles with finger-object interaction, leading to fusion artifacts. The 'black' gown prior in the taxonomy should be treated as a common case, not a strict rule, so do not penalize the yellow color if the structure is correct.
